title: New law: Independent Counsel Reauthorization Act of 1994 (Public Law 103-270)
summary: S. 24 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-270 on 1994-06-30.

title: New law: To amend title 11, D.C. Code, to clarify that blind individuals are eligible to serve as jurors in the Superior Court of the District of Columbia. (Public Law 103-269)
summary: H.R. 4205 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-269 on 1994-06-28.

title: New law: To designate the Post Office building located at 401 E. South Street in Jackson, Mississippi, as the "Medgar Wiley Evers Post Office". (Public Law 103-265)
summary: H.R. 3863 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-265 on 1994-06-10.

title: New law: To amend the District of Columbia Spouse Equity Act of 1988 to provide for coverage of the former spouses of judges of the District of Columbia courts. (Public Law 103-268)
summary: H.R. 3676 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-268 on 1994-06-28.

title: New law: To amend title 11, District of Columbia Code, to remove gender-specific references. (Public Law 103-266)
summary: H.R. 1632 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-266 on 1994-06-13.

title: New law: Child Safety Protection Act (Public Law 103-267)
summary: H.R. 965 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-267 on 1994-06-16.
